title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 20
description: Ten questions on Exodus 20: the Ten Commandments, the people's fear at the mountain and the law of the altar.

questions.text: Out of which land does God say he brought the people, at the start of the commandments?
questions.explanation: God said: 'I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.'

questions.text: To which generations does God visit the iniquity of the fathers on those who hate him?
questions.explanation: God visits the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate him.

answers.text: The third and the fourth generation

questions.text: Which day were the people to remember and keep holy?
questions.explanation: The commandment says: 'Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.'

answers.text: The day of the new moon
The first day of the year

questions.text: What reason does the commandment give for keeping the Sabbath?
questions.explanation: In six days Yahweh made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day.

answers.text: The manna did not fall from heaven on that day
The land and its fields needed time to rest
The priests needed one day for their sacrifices
Yahweh made everything in six days and rested the seventh

questions.text: What promise comes with the command to honor your father and mother?
questions.explanation: Honor your father and your mother, 'that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.'

answers.text: That your days may be long in the land
That your children will honor you
That you will have many sons

questions.text: Besides his house and wife, which possession of your neighbor does the last commandment name?
questions.explanation: You shall not covet your neighbor's house, wife, male servant, female servant, ox, donkey, or anything that is your neighbor's.

questions.text: What did the trembling people ask Moses?
questions.explanation: They said: 'Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don't let God speak with us, lest we die.'

answers.text: That Moses take them back to Egypt
That Aaron go up the mountain instead
That Moses build them an altar at once
That Moses speak with them, not God, lest they die

questions.text: According to Moses, why had God come?
questions.explanation: Moses said: 'Don't be afraid, for God has come to test you, and that his fear may be before you, that you won't sin.'

answers.text: To punish them for their murmuring
To test them, so that they would not sin
To give them the land right away
To choose a king for them

questions.text: Of what did Yahweh tell them to make an altar for him?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said: 'You shall make an altar of earth for me, and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings.'

questions.text: What would pollute an altar of stone?
questions.explanation: An altar of stone was not to be built of cut stones, 'for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.'

answers.text: Lifting up a tool on it
